The total number of soaps sold by companies Q and S together in May, is what percentage more than the number of soaps sold by company P in July
solution:
**Given:**

Sales of company Q in May = 1540 soaps

Sales of company S in May = 1736 soaps

Sales of company P in July = 1820 soaps

**Formula Used:**

Percentage difference = ((Total sales of Q and S in May - Sales of P in July) / Sales of P in July) × 100%
